scope: Same 1204 cached observed Train states, 11044 sampled parent-continuation rollouts, 928 fit / 276 held states, frozen encoder and 350->128->2 numeric head. Reuse completed uniform-control runs whose exact inputs, initial weights and update budgets are pinned; do not retrain identical controls.
sampling: Half uniform across fitting states; half uniform across benchmark, observed response category, source family, and state. Categories are initial/answered/partial/unanswered from past request answers only, excluding retrieval. No losses, correctness, state labels, hidden environment or held-source data in probabilities.
hypothesis: Four retail fitting states have a failed mandatory response and a remaining query (0.431% of uniform samples). Their initial mean gradient opposes the global mean (cosine -0.794), while inherited Tanh activations frequently saturate. Change sampling alone; this experiment does not isolate or claim to fix saturation.
gates: All three seeds must improve chosen-action held-Train target loss over their numeric uniform control, worsen neither benchmark and add no expected false handoffs. Keep the identical equal-family/equal-benchmark criterion, with the initial head eligible and earliest strict improvement selected. Only then compare actual sequential Train outcomes with independently sampled responses before any full refit/Dev validation.

sequentialTrainCheck.requirement: Compare each inner selected candidate and its corresponding uniform head on the same original Train episodes and common response draws. Require lower equal-benchmark normalized mean loss across all three seeds, neither benchmark worse, and no more false handoffs. Finite controlled Train check, not independent effectiveness.
